study_context.study_scope: Fresh ORIGINAL comprehension measurement for the no-undo / can-undo(<how>) claim carrier (proposal action-no-undo-action-can-undo-how-4; work item submit_original), filed 2026-09-10. 32 wholly fresh real items (16 can-undo + 16 no-undo, equal-weight strata) + 8 controls. Every item is an action report or instruction followed by a situation and an anchor (platform log, note or rule) that pins the truth; the held-out question uses vocabulary disjoint from the mapping's. Answers turn on the anchor, not on the tag's plain reading, because a prior ceiling null on the predecessor revision (both arms 1.0) showed an item set where the tag alone answers the question cannot resolve this construct. Answer space is 3 options (chance 1/3). The reader roster is a single declared remote member, deepseek-flash (one provider lineage), so panel_neff is declared 1 and no reader-decorrelation is claimed; it is a single-principal result and does not speak for readers outside that panel.

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
